payload.name: Capture Explicit Pet and Possession Names
payload.description: During extraction, when a speaker introduces a pet or owned item and states its proper name, include the name in the memory.
content: During extraction, when a speaker introduces or refers to a pet or owned item with an explicit proper name (e.g., 'This is [name]', 'my [item] [name]'), include that name in the ownership or relationship memory; do not store only the emotional or preference aspect.
If multiple named pets or items are mentioned, capture each stated name in the relevant memory so name-based queries are answerable.
During CRUD, when updating an existing pet or possession memory, preserve any recorded names; keep the memory compact and stop after recording owner, item type, and stated names.

solves: During extraction, the agent may record the emotional or general aspect of a statement (e.g., a pet brings comfort) while dropping explicitly stated proper names, so later questions asking for those names cannot be answered. This skill ensures that named identifying details are captured whenever a speaker introduces a pet or owned entity.
